verdict.rationale: Orb is a billing and invoicing platform, so tax calculation on invoices is a fair axis. The evidence pack never mentions sales tax, VAT, GST, tax registrations, rates, or a tax-provider integration (e.g. Avalara or Anrok). The invoice-calculation evidence covers only minimums and maximums.

support.subject: As a finance lead, sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated on every invoice — natively or through a first-class tax integration — with the right registrations and rates
